title: Post-add capability probe and OS prerequisite warnings
summary: Add a post-add capability probe and catalog metadata for OS prerequisites to prevent false-success states for MCP servers that require platform permissions
before_state: Quick-add registration workflow declares an MCP server fully successful based only on config validity
after_state: Quick-add registration workflow runs a post-add probe against the registered server before declaring success and shows clear actionable warnings for missing OS permissions or environmental prerequisites
